title: Death's Door
provenance: Reported by SnoopyHuman (highball-db#97, 2026-09-17), Apple M5, macOS 27, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, DXVK, Epic copy, rated 5 of 5 after 3 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXVK after a three-minute session on an M5, Epic copy, so this covers launch and the opening. The Steam id here is the same game on Steam. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: The player and enemies are invisible while the level draws (reported on an M1 Max with DXVK, highball#219)
knownIssues.cause: Not measured here. The other report, on an M5 with the same DXVK mode, had no such problem, so the older chip is the likely difference
knownIssues.fix: Untested. Set Mode for this game to DXMT on the game's page, under Advanced
